title: Agent-ready Design System Completeness — Contracts, Composition and Design Craft
scope: Product-independent research synthesis; not a product design system or implementation.

patterns.name: Component Intent / Selection Rules
patterns.behavior: Document purpose, use/avoid conditions, action outcome and alternatives, rather than only names.
patterns.acceptance: Given submit, save and continue, select the correct action and explain its outcome.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Component Behavioral Contract
patterns.behavior: Specify props, events, guards, transitions, accessibility, responsiveness and composition; separate visual appearance from behavior.
patterns.acceptance: Given allowed state and trigger, expected next state and side effects are testable.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: State vs Variant / State Matrix
patterns.behavior: Separate configuration axes from runtime states, including valid combinations and error paths.
patterns.acceptance: Loading+disabled and selected+focus combinations render and behave predictably.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Component Anatomy and Slots
patterns.behavior: Define parts, slots, boundaries, required content and semantic relationships before choosing a framework.
patterns.acceptance: Map each slot to an implementation and test missing/long content.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Typed Component Schema
patterns.behavior: Encode valid values, defaults, references and constraints using structured data; do not rely on name inference.
patterns.acceptance: Reject invalid enum, unsupported prop and illegal composition in validation.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Semantic Token Chain
patterns.behavior: Map primitives to semantic intent and component role where appropriate; avoid unapproved raw values.
patterns.acceptance: Trace token from role to theme value and check light/dark usage.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Composition Rules / Design Grammar
patterns.behavior: Define allowed structures and relationships, negative constraints, dependencies and alternatives; assess the assembled screen.
patterns.acceptance: Compare whole screen with task and hierarchy, not isolated specimens.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Composition Recipes / Templates
patterns.behavior: Provide representative combinations with context, variants, slots and counterexamples; avoid mandatory generic layouts.
patterns.acceptance: Assemble two realistic flows from approved recipes and identify unsupported cases.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Spatial Rhythm / Information Density
patterns.behavior: Define relationships between internal spacing and separation of groups, density by task and size.
patterns.acceptance: Compare dense workspace and reading layout; no clipping or false grouping.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Optical Alignment / Visual Weight
patterns.behavior: Use perceptual correction for icons, typography and alignment; document justified exceptions.
patterns.acceptance: Inspect rendered alignment at actual sizes and compare with reference.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Visual Hierarchy / Art Direction
patterns.behavior: Prioritize content using scale, weight, spacing, contrast and visual thesis appropriate to product type.
patterns.acceptance: User can identify primary task; visual references and rendered review support hierarchy.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Visual Restraint / Container Discipline
patterns.behavior: Use grouping and surfaces for meaningful content boundaries, not generic card nesting or decoration.
patterns.acceptance: Remove unnecessary borders/cards while preserving information and affordance.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Responsive / Overflow Contract
patterns.behavior: Define container behavior, long content, reflow, scroll, expansion, input modalities and edge cases.
patterns.acceptance: Test narrow and wide layouts, zoom, long text and actual input behavior.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Microinteraction and Motion Contract
patterns.behavior: Reference existing state, tooltip, motion and workspace behavior catalogs; define trigger, feedback, timing and interruption per component.
patterns.acceptance: Hover/focus/touch and reduced-motion scenarios work without semantic delays.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: UX Contract / Cross-screen Coherence
patterns.behavior: Record user task, behavior, failure recovery and evidence-linked requirements across flow boundaries.
patterns.acceptance: Follow end-to-end task with errors and return navigation; verify consistency.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Progressive Context Disclosure
patterns.behavior: Keep global direction compact; index task-specific specs and fetch only relevant authoritative details.
patterns.acceptance: Agent finds correct registry/spec with bounded context; unresolved dependency is explicit.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Machine-readable Context / MCP plus Skills
patterns.behavior: Separate live component facts from composition, usage and interaction guidance; test tool access and fallback.
patterns.acceptance: Agent selects existing component from authoritative registry instead of inventing it.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Queryable Usage and Anti-pattern Metadata
patterns.behavior: Encode use cases, selection conditions, exclusions, rationale and alternatives; preserve prose for nuance.
patterns.acceptance: Query suitable component and reject documented misuse; avoid treating heuristic as universal.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Spec-driven Component Development
patterns.behavior: Normalize shared intent and deterministic transforms where feasible; separate authoring, publishing and consumption.
patterns.acceptance: Compare spec to design/code/docs; verify generated outputs before use.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Specification Round-trip Fidelity
patterns.behavior: Reconstruct from spec, re-extract, diff dropped/distorted/invented information; include semantic and visual checks.
patterns.acceptance: Baseline vs re-extracted data highlights losses; no claim of fidelity from schema alone.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Design System Governance / Drift Control
patterns.behavior: Define approved source, version and human review; propose missing capabilities instead of silent custom forks.
patterns.acceptance: Detect invented props/tokens, review gaps, record approved changes and exceptions.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Design Quality Gates
patterns.behavior: Review rendered visuals, task fit, states, accessibility, responsiveness and cross-screen consistency before acceptance.
patterns.acceptance: Evidence matrix records pass/fail/untested and fixes; static screenshot alone insufficient.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Interaction and Visual Acceptance Testing
patterns.behavior: Use isolated initial states and interaction assertions plus visual comparison and end-to-end tasks where relevant.
patterns.acceptance: Run keyboard/touch, pending/error/empty and responsive scenarios; verify actual outcomes.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Context Strategy Evaluation
patterns.behavior: Compare same task and conditions across design artifacts, skills and MCP; measure tokens, latency and quality separately.
patterns.acceptance: Record baselines, model/version, sample and scope; don't generalize single-task results.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Design System Completeness Audit
patterns.behavior: Check foundations, anatomy, states, behavior, composition, content, responsive, motion, accessibility and verification; use references rather than duplicating all knowledge.
patterns.acceptance: Identify missing contract fields, evidence and explicit not-applicable cases.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

patterns.name: Visual Reference and Evidence
patterns.behavior: Use relevant rendered examples, reference images and real product structure to guide composition; check rights and distinguish observation from inference.
patterns.acceptance: Inspect desktop/mobile screenshot and actual behavior; record source and limits.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesized recommendation; not a formal universal standard

sources.title: Component Contracts: The missing piece for AI-era Design System handoff
sources.finding: Behavioral JSON contracts capture props, transitions, triggers, events, accessibility, responsiveness and composition; tokens/Figma cover appearance. Practitioner case, not universal validation.

sources.title: Agentic Design Systems
sources.finding: Separate UI and UX contracts; link behavioral requirements to evidence and tests, keep human interpretation and decisions.

sources.title: Design system contracts: the component lives in neither Figma nor code
sources.finding: Structured shared contract limits drift across design and code; reported A/B numbers are attributed to Southleft, not independently replicated.

sources.title: Your Buttons Need More Than Names: Documenting Component Intent
sources.finding: Purpose, use and avoid contexts, expected activation outcome, feedback, accessibility and exceptions; proposed template, not validated trial.

sources.title: States vs. Variants: The Most Misunderstood Concept in Design Systems
sources.finding: Available introduction distinguishes temporary behavior from structural identity; full member-only body not inspected.

sources.title: The Illusion of the Perfect Screen
sources.finding: Search-index excerpt emphasizes transitions and non-default states; full member-only article not read.

sources.title: The Realities of Getting a Design System Ready for AI
sources.finding: Societe Generale case: structured asset markup, prop tables, examples, guidelines, instructions, skills and testing; context scope matters.

sources.title: How to Make Your Design System Agent-Ready
sources.finding: Tokens plus concise global DESIGN.md, registries and individual component/pattern/template files; separate authoring, specification and delivery.

sources.title: DESIGN.md + a skill
sources.finding: Separate method from product content, route to references on demand, compare same briefs and require explicit review before changing system knowledge.

sources.title: AI-generated UI - from generic defaults to production-ready screens
sources.finding: Proposed repeatable validation of generated screens: responsive/accessibility, coherence across flows, brand and contextual suitability, repair rather than appearance alone.

sources.title: Como preparei meu design system para ser lido por uma IA
sources.finding: Separate system creation from consumption; primitive-semantic-component token chain and consult existing Storybook before assembling screens.

sources.title: Fully Machine-Readable Design Systems
sources.finding: MCP supplies current component facts, plugin supplies use, composition, spacing and taste; progressive context disclosure; one case study is not a universal benchmark.

sources.title: Component Contracts and Schemas
sources.finding: Typed, constrained properties and explicit relationships make design intent checkable and allow deterministic transformations.

sources.title: What Component Specs Leave Behind
sources.finding: Generate baseline spec, render asset, generate new spec, diff; detect dropped, distorted or invented information.

sources.title: Spec-Driven UI Component Development
sources.finding: Normalize and version intent across authoring surfaces; use deterministic generation where possible, verify parity across Figma, prototypes and code.

sources.title: Foundations, Rules, and Context
sources.finding: Title and introduction support three layers and warn that scraping code also inherits legacy inconsistencies; full body unavailable.

sources.title: Design system documentation as structured metadata
sources.finding: Queryable usage, variant purpose, selection criteria and antipatterns with reasons and alternatives; proposed metadata, not a universal schema.

sources.title: The Art of Putting Things Back Together
sources.finding: Component quality in isolation does not assure composition quality; respect boundaries and evaluate relationships and whole workflows.

sources.title: Visual Craft Standards
sources.finding: Distinguish brand and product registers; grouping, hierarchy, spacing, alignment and restrained containers. Numeric thresholds are author heuristics, not requirements.

sources.title: The Design System as the Control Plane for AI-Generated UI
sources.finding: Govern component APIs and agent rules; review gaps and new patterns intentionally rather than letting almost-standard components proliferate.

sources.title: LLM Context Design
sources.finding: Three layers: semantic tokens, usage specs and audit loop; explicit rules needed for edge cases.

sources.title: Visual Alignment
sources.finding: Optical versus mathematical alignment, grouping, baseline rhythm and whitespace; adjust by perceptual evidence.

sources.title: Why Does a Design Look Good?
sources.finding: 2021 examples of consistent type, hierarchy, restrained color palette and alignment grid; not a 2026 invention.

sources.title: Design Principles for Software Engineers
sources.finding: Guide updated August 2026 covers proximity, visual fundamentals, motion, web and AI patterns; spacing examples are illustrative.

sources.title: DesignSpecs preprint
sources.finding: 13 Nov 2026 preprint: repository corpus, not a causal evaluation of generated UI or all design systems; earlier reported section frequencies are not comprehensive behavior analysis.

sources.title: DesignSpecs dataset
sources.finding: Dataset endpoint could not be reopened; retain URL without asserting independent inspection.

sources.title: Google DESIGN.md specification
sources.finding: Current spec supports root-relative external references in code spans and optional ordered sections; validate actual version and reference targets.

sources.title: Atlassian DESIGN.md
sources.finding: Actual versioned portable token/prose example; not evidence that this artifact alone captures all production requirements.

sources.title: Atlassian DESIGN.md practical test
sources.finding: June 15 2026 login-task test: DESIGN.md 7.21M vs MCP 3.75M average tokens, about 92% more, and reported 2.7x variance; authors explicitly caution results are inconclusive.

sources.title: UI Anatomy methodology
sources.finding: Document component anatomy independently of implementation, then map to implementations.

sources.title: Carbon component checklist
sources.finding: Component specs must describe behavior such as reflow, overflow, expansion, scrolling and accessibility for implementation.

sources.title: Vercel Web Interface Guidelines
sources.finding: Living practical guidance on interaction, layout, accessibility and performance; not a formal standard.

sources.title: OpenAI Frontend prompt instructions
sources.finding: Avoid generic nested cards and decorative clutter; stable layouts, fitting text and desktop/mobile rendered verification; adapt to existing systems.

sources.title: Designing delightful frontends with GPT-5.4
sources.finding: Visual thesis, composition, reference imagery and constraints; promotional hero advice should not be imposed on dense applications.

sources.title: Storybook interaction tests
sources.finding: Stories define initial state; play functions simulate actions and assert results. Isolated tests complement, not replace, end-to-end and accessibility tests.

sources.title: Awesome DESIGN.md
sources.finding: Collection of brand-derived design files for examples; not official specifications for every brand or proof of completeness.

caveats: Review date 2026-11-25. All 24 links from the latest answer attempted; additional 12 earlier references included. Article-body means relevant public sections inspected, not exhaustive reading. Two direct article fetches failed and indexed material was used; two other articles were member previews. Dataset inaccessible.

No paywall bypass, verbatim article copying, private screenshots, or claims of population-wide adoption. Source cases and numbers are not independently replicated. Preserve existing URLs and source metadata.

Use actual system requirements and reference examples; do not turn visual heuristics, generic marketing defaults, or author-specific thresholds into universal rules. DESIGN.md is a portable artifact, not inherently a deficient format; completeness depends on contents, references, tools and evaluation.

Keep canonical contracts and component implementation authoritative. Treat external references as version-specific; Google specification paths resolve from DESIGN.md directory, not the referencing file. Avoid duplicate contradictory instructions.
This catalog cross-indexes earlier behavioral, workspace, microinteraction and motion patterns; counts are indexed entries rather than all-new unique concepts.
